items.title: Jay Leonhart interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: my daughter Carol was born in 1971

ctx.x: And your children were born, let me figure, late 70s?
Well, my daughter Carol was born in 1971, my son Michael was born in 1974.
Okay. And that’s when you started to — was your pick-up of the electric bass, no pun intended, that was about that time?
